doc: Hull-token registry (W3-B). The governor (tools/build_ui_art.py) renders the two authored maps per hull into staging, derives the other six directions with the pinned lossless ops below, applies the 1px HULL_INK outline, then bakes the 9 owner variants via the wood-step remap table. Contract: docs/80-UI-UX.md §4.8 (heading8→dir table §4.8.6, tier footprint bands §4.8.7, hull block §4.8.4) and docs/10-DATA-SCHEMA.md §8.8 group 13.
staging: authored maps render into a transient staging dir (they are outline-less wood-colored intermediates; the wood-colored map itself is not a shipped file — every owner variant, neutral included, is a remap target per §4.8.4 hull block)

derive._doc: op semantics verified on screen (y-down): rot_cw of a north-facing sprite points the bow east. Pinned identically in every authored/*.json so group 13 re-checks the same relations.

outline.rule: 8-neighborhood: transparent pixels adjacent (8-way) to opaque ones take HULL_INK

footprint._doc: long axis = n-token opaque bbox max dimension, measured on the final (outlined) file; tier bands per 80-* §4.8.7 (ship_types.tier partition 4/8/4, review-verified)
